about: Holding a particle of the Host over the chalice, the priest signs the chalice three times with it and gives the greeting of peace. The server answers.

s01.narrative: Holding the particle over the chalice, the priest makes three signs of the cross with it.

s02.translation: May the peace of the Lord always be with you.

w005.function: Ablative plural of vos with -cum attached.

w008.function: An ablative after “cum” (w007), in the response “Et cum spíritu tuo”.
